summary.zh: 审数据授权、架构选型与数据变现
summary.en: Challenge training-data rights, data architecture, and monetization.

description.zh: 在批准用客户数据训练模型、签多年数据基础设施合同或把数据做成产品之前，追问数据支撑哪个决策、授权来自哪里、内部消费方有多少。也用于并购尽调前的数据盘点。
description.en: Questions what decision the data unlocks, where consent comes from, and how many internal consumers justify the architecture, before a training run, a multi-year data platform contract, or a data product. Useful ahead of M&A diligence.
